subject: Onboarding check & agreement call — timeline-sensitive
messages:
From: Michael Turner <michael.turner@atlaspay.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Sally Chen <sally.chen@atlaspay.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding check-in + agreement call (procurement deadline week)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Procurement at AtlasPay has pushed our internal deadline up and we'd like to lock a short onboarding check-in this week that also covers the outstanding MSA comments — ideally a 30–45 minute call to close any redlines and confirm next steps for SSO and evidence upload.

Our team is available (PT):
- Fri 2/13: 9:30–11:00, 14:00–16:00
- Mon 2/16: 08:00–11:30

If those don't work, happy to propose alternatives — we just need to make progress before the end of next week. I'll loop procurement if we need to surface any contract-specific asks.

Thanks,
Michael Turner
Head of Procurement, AtlasPay
michael.turner@atlaspay.com
+1 (415) 555‑0148
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -0800

Hi Michael — appreciate the heads up and the proposed windows.

Quick notes:
- I'll be the primary host for the onboarding agenda and run the call.
- I've looped Hannah (legal) for the MSA redline close and Ben (onboarding) for implementation/SSO items.

Proposed consolidated slots (PT):
- Fri 2/13, 10:00–10:45 (suggested)
- Fri 2/13, 15:00–15:45 (fall-back)

Hannah / Ben — can you confirm availability for the 10:00 slot? If not, we'll aim for 15:00. Also Hannah, we'll need the short evidence checklist and any contract comments pre-read so we can close on the call.

I'll draft a short agenda and share a Drive link + calendar invite once we lock the time.

—Lauren

lauren@redwood.com | (650) 555‑0199

Lauren, that 10:00 slot would be perfect if you and legal can do it. Procurement will join the first 20 minutes and then hand off to our engineering lead for the SSO checklist.

One quick ask — if legal can surface any non-standard liability/retention items prior to the meeting (even bullet points) procurement can prep escalation if needed.

Thanks — confirming 2/13 10:00 PT for now. I'll accept the invite when it hits.

—Michael
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 13:10:00 -0800

Thanks for the ping. I can do 2/13 at 10:00 PT.

Attached is the evidence checklist and a short note on the remaining MSA items we expect to resolve in a single call:
- Data retention: propose standard 90-day transient logs + 1 yr user metadata retention (customer-configurable)
- Liability cap: proposed to remain as-is, but we can flag exceptions if AtlasPay requires a higher cap — will need procurement business sponsor approval
- Subprocessors: default list is attached; any additions require a 30‑day notice

I attached evidence-checklist.pdf and a draft service_agreement_v1.docx (redline summary). Please review before the call; I can share screen for any live redline decisions.

Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

2) 15m — legal redline review & confirm edits (Hannah)
3) 10m — implementation checklist & SSO pre-flight (Ben)
4) 5m — next steps, DocuSign link and timeline

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_agenda.pdf, draft_service_agreement_v1.docx

Ben will take notes and own the SSO items. Michael — if procurement confirms there are any escalation items after this call, we will capture them and route to the right execs.

—Lauren
